# slack_users (Data Source)

Lists all users visible to the configured token using Slack's `users.list` API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "slack_users" "all" {}

output "slack_user_ids" {
  value = [for user in data.slack_users.all.users : user.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `team_id` (String) Workspace ID to list. Required when using an organization-level token and ignored by Slack for workspace-level tokens.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) Users returned by Slack, including invited and deleted/deactivated users. Results are sorted by `id` for stable Terraform state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) User's display color.
- `deleted` (Boolean) Whether the user is deactivated.
- `id` (String) Slack user ID.
- `is_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is a workspace administrator.
- `is_app_user` (Boolean) Whether the user is an app user.
- `is_bot` (Boolean) Whether the user is a bot.
- `is_owner` (Boolean) Whether the user is a workspace owner.
- `is_primary_owner` (Boolean) Whether the user is the workspace primary owner.
- `is_restricted` (Boolean) Whether the user is a guest.
- `is_ultra_restricted` (Boolean) Whether the user is a single-channel guest.
- `locale` (String) User's locale, when available.
- `name` (String) Username.
- `profile` (Attributes) Slack user profile. The token needs the `users:read.email` scope for `email` to be populated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--profile))
- `real_name` (String) User's real name.
- `team_id` (String) Slack workspace ID.
- `tz` (String) IANA time zone name.
- `tz_label` (String) Human-readable time zone label.
- `tz_offset` (Number) Time zone offset from UTC in seconds.
- `updated` (Number) Unix timestamp when the user was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--users--profile"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.profile`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `display_name_normalized` (String) Normalized display name.
- `email` (String) Email address, when permitted by token scopes.
- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `image_192` (String) 192 pixel avatar URL.
- `image_24` (String) 24 pixel avatar URL.
- `image_32` (String) 32 pixel avatar URL.
- `image_48` (String) 48 pixel avatar URL.
- `image_512` (String) 512 pixel avatar URL.
- `image_72` (String) 72 pixel avatar URL.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `phone` (String) Phone number.
- `real_name` (String) Real name.
- `real_name_normalized` (String) Normalized real name.
- `status_emoji` (String) Status emoji.
- `status_text` (String) Status text.
- `title` (String) Job title.
